assertion_audit.451: Independent expected widths [1,2,3,0,3,None] fail on exclusive endpoint handling, counting malformed/reversed spans or using stored widths.
assertion_audit.452: Independent durations [600,600,0,0,None,None] fail on forwarding stored 9999, changing clamping of reversed spans or fabricating missing durations.
assertion_audit.455: The rejecting ledger.runs instrument raises if explicitly supplied records (including empty ones) cause a second ledger read.
assertion_audit.467: Selected-versus-full equality fails when selection loses rows, fails to preserve empty inputs or counts width from selected records instead of the separate fleet population; the full-path figures are independently anchored at 451-452, so shared figure errors cannot hide solely behind parity.
assertion_audit.468: The literal 9999 input check fails if deriving duration mutates the caller-owned records.
assertion_audit.492: The literal three-row cardinality fails on lost or added selected rows and makes the following all() sentinel check non-vacuous.
assertion_audit.493: The single-call expectation fails if the stored reader bypasses the owner or invokes it repeatedly; the recorded prior-head reproduction fails here.
assertion_audit.494: Equality against the independently constructed fixture _rows() fails if delegation drops or alters selected payload fields.
assertion_audit.495-498: Timestamp projection keys fail if unrelated full record fields are passed to the owner; this is a shape guard, not by itself proof of a nonempty fleet population, which 451/467 and the retained width bound check establish.
assertion_audit.499-501: Owner-injected width 12345 and duration 54321 fail to reach the caller if the ledger independently recomputes either value; this intentionally tests delegation, and restoring the prior duplicate computation fails 493 before these assertions, rather than creating a tautological numerical oracle.
